title: Include the ability to specify pass file location
line: The Pass widget's settings now have a General page where you can choose which password store folder it shows.
explanation: The Pass widget always read the store from $PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or ~/.password-store, and had no settings page at all, so using a store elsewhere meant changing the whole session's environment. The change adds a General settings page with a folder field and a folder picker that converts between file URLs and paths properly (spaces, accents and # survive); the model gains a passwordStoreDirectory property (empty keeps the old behaviour, ~ is expanded), loads the store once when the widget is created and reloads the list and its file watcher when the setting changes.

commits.message:
config: add a setting for the password store location

The widget could only read the store from $PASSWORD_STORE_DIR or
~/.password-store, so using another folder meant changing the session's
environment. Add a General page to choose it, and reload the list live.

BUG: 522100

media.caption: The widget can only show the default store (~/.password-store).
After choosing ~/work-store in the settings, the widget lists that store right away.
Settings only have Keyboard Shortcuts and About; no way to pick the store.
New General page with a password store location field and folder picker.
First version of the page: picking the folder "Pass Störe #2" saved it as "Pass Störe %232".
Now the picked folder is saved with its real name, "Pass Störe #2".
With the mangled path the widget found no store and showed an empty list.
With the correct path the widget lists the store's servers, jira and vpn.
